comparison.objective: Turn both faucet handles fully open; candidate tunes and locks a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual grasping and 120° handle sweeps versus recessed-key manipulation, body counterholding, fine collar adjustment, and bounded tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Each handle within 15° of open and still seated versus two validated carriage cycles and lock retention. No separate spec versions were provided.
comparison.reason: Shared rotational manipulation is generic; the faucet task lacks iterative response calibration and locking.
